questions: Does the function return the number of collisions (as in the reference solution) or a 'record' (e.g., list of collision events/times/participants) as the docstring says?
Are the cars within each set equally spaced or arbitrarily positioned initially?
Do we assume the left-to-right and right-to-left sets start infinitely far apart but with some specific ordering (e.g., each set ordered along the line)?
Is the speed constant and identical for all cars, and if so, what is the exact value (e.g., 1 unit per time)?
Should collisions be counted only between distinct pairs, or do multi-car simultaneous collisions count differently?
Does 'very far from each other' imply the left-to-right cars are all to the left of all right-to-left cars initially?
Is the road one-dimensional, and cars are points with no size, so they pass through each other?
What does 'record' mean if not a count? Could it be a list of tuples (i, j) for each collision between i-th left-to-right and j-th right-to-left car?
